*Quebecor: Under Proposal, TELUS Hldrs Would Receive C$6.35 in Cash and 0.1700 Class B Shrs of Quebecor for Each TELUS Shr >QBR.A.T
*Quebecor: Proposal Represents About C$19.451 Per Shr, a Premium of About 60% to TELUS's Closing Shr Price on the Toronto Stk Exchange on Nov 13 >QBR.A.T
